Definition: Sources disagree whether a concept exists
Example: Patient reports penicillin anaphylaxis; allergy list says no known allergy
Required behaviour: Preserve both, prioritise safety, clarify/retrieve/clinician review
FHIR/workflow representation: DetectedIssue + Task; candidate AllergyIntolerance remains unconfirmed

Definition: Sources refer to different patient/person/resource identity
Example: Imported record identifiers do not match patient
Required behaviour: Stop affected synthesis/write-back and invoke identity workflow

Definition: Reported actual use differs from prescription/order
Example: Patient stopped empagliflozin but active MedicationRequest remains
Required behaviour: Represent both event types, ask last dose/reason, reconcile

Example: Patient says apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily; list says 5 mg
Required behaviour: Do not choose silently; clarify using label/list/pharmacy/clinician

Example: Last rivaroxaban dose yesterday vs record administration today
Required behaviour: Clarify and retain event/source times separately

Definition: Different labels may be synonymous, hierarchical or genuinely different
Required behaviour: Terminology service tests equivalence/subsumption; clarify if clinically non-equivalent

Definition: Sources agree on event but disagree severity
Required behaviour: Prefer source with event detail for phenotype while retaining patient account; escalate material discrepancy

Example: Old problem list says active asthma; patient says no symptoms/treatment for years
Required behaviour: Separate historical diagnosis from current clinical status; clarify current state

Definition: Planned procedure differs between patient understanding and booking/order
Example: Patient expects left knee, booking says right knee
Required behaviour: Stop routine assumption and trigger human verification

Definition: Two versions of same source disagree
Required behaviour: Use version/time, retain supersession lineage and assess whether older source still clinically relevant

Definition: AI extraction differs across model/pass or contradicts source text
Example: Transcript says 'no diabetes', extractor produces diabetes present
Required behaviour: Fail closed: retain source, mark extraction unresolved, reprocess/clarify
FHIR/workflow representation: Internal quality issue + no authoritative write-back

Example: AI summary says DVT; patient corrects to PE
Required behaviour: Correction becomes new assertion; previous extraction retained but no longer current interpretation

Example: Patient gives symptoms, record gives exact drug name
Required behaviour: Merge into composite fact only with source attribution per component

Definition: Older source contradicts newer credible source
Example: 2019 smoker flag vs patient quit in 2024
Required behaviour: Prefer temporally appropriate assertion for current state while retaining history
